instructions.nest-framework: When working with Nest framework code, always prefer using existing crates from core/crates/ and modules/crates/. Before introducing a new dependency or implementing common functionality, check whether a Nest crate already provides the capability.
instructions.dependency-rules: Respect layer boundaries: core must not depend on modules or apps. Modules should not depend on apps. Apps may depend on any core or module crate.
instructions.error-handling: Use NestError and NestResult from nest-error for all error handling in Nest applications.
instructions.logging: Use nest-logging for logging setup with tracing.
instructions.tauri-apps: For desktop apps, use nest-tauri host with React + TypeScript + Tailwind in ui/ folder.
instructions.memory-workflow: ALWAYS start by searching project documentation and prior context before implementation. Read order: 1) docs/architecture.md, 2) docs/plan/, 3) project memory (nest-memory MCP), 4) knowledge base (nest-knowledge MCP for Rust/Tauri/React/Tailwind APIs), 5) context memory (nest-context-memory MCP), 6) source code under core/crates/ and modules/crates/.
instructions.desktop-ui: When building desktop UI (ui/, Tauri): search knowledge collections 'tauri', 'react', 'tailwind' via nest-knowledge MCP server.
instructions.post-response: After every response, save context memory via nest-context-memory MCP server with: what you did, files changed, decisions, blockers, and verification commands/results.
